name: ms-social-security-contributions
description: Montserrat social security contribution reference for 2026, covering ordinary employee and employer rates, weekly and monthly earnings ceilings, insurable pay and remittance timing. Uses the official revised legislation and the Fund’s 2026 monthly rate table. Includes payroll examples and distinguishes the employment-injury component already included in the employer rate. Use after employment coverage and the contribution period have been established. Age-transition weeks, exempt payments and the difference between earnings rounding and contribution amounts are addressed. Self-employed assessments, benefits and post-pensionable-age injury arrangements need separate review. This source-cited draft awaits independent accountant review.
